Subject: Scheduling: virtual onsite for Product Engineer — Samantha Ortiz

Hi all,

Samantha (cc'd) is ready to move to a full virtual onsite. Candidate is Pacific Time (PT). She prefers mornings PT, but can stretch into early afternoon. I'm proposing 4 interview slots + 30m buffer/debrief after the loop. Options below — please indicate availability and any sequencing constraints by EOD so I can lock invites.

Option A (preferred by candidate) — Tue 27 Jun (PT)
- 08:00–08:45 PT: System design (Marissa)
- 09:00–09:30 PT: Product/PM + behavioral (Karthik)
- 09:45–10:15 PT: Deep dive: code & architecture (Marissa / backup)
- 10:30–11:00 PT: Culture & collaboration (Laura to cover if needed)
- 11:00–11:30 PT: Buffer + immediate debrief (internal only)

Option B — Wed 28 Jun (PT) — same slot ordering but shifted + 1hr

Notes/asks:
- Can we avoid putting system design last — candidate gets fatigued. Karthik, you mentioned wanting the behavioral earlier to set context — please confirm.
- Marissa: would you prefer a single longer design slot (50m) instead of two short bits? If yes, we should move coding earlier.
- Laura: please confirm whether interviewing ops can create the calendar invites and include virtual room + access doc.

Attachments: Samantha_Ortiz_Resume.pdf, slot-mapping-v2.csv

Thanks — once I get confirmations I'll send calendar invites and candidate prep notes.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor

Thanks Neha — quick notes:

- Confirmed: Tue 27 Jun works for me (morning PT).
- Please put behavioral (product/context) before system design — I want to set product expectations early. Suggested order: 1) Behavioral/product (30m) 2) System design (45–50m) 3) Code/architecture (30m) 4) Culture/collab (30m) + 30m debrief.
- Marissa: if you prefer a single design block, I'm fine with 50m; we can trim code to 25–30m accordingly.

On buffers: please add a 10–15m hard buffer between interviews to allow for quick notes and technical hiccups. Also recommend including a short "prep doc" for interviewers with the rubric link so scoring is consistent.

On candidate prep: Neha, attach the one-page loop agenda to the calendar invite (candidate-facing).

Thanks — I'll be on the Product/behavior session.
